scope: Evidence/disposition subreview findings for integration into the root single FPR-5 verdict. No standalone verdict.

findings.title: Historical local-app flow mappings omit maintained HTTP outcomes
findings.problem: The audit marks the original app gates/review/full-flow failures as successor-covered, but their successors never execute the maintained successful HTTP outcomes. The selected sources exercise /api/review/freeze only with ../outside.md (refusal), /api/ledger/show only with an invalid limit (request rejection), and no /api/gates, /api/ledger/verify or /api/honesty-status success path. CLI review/ledger/honesty tests do not exercise the request-body-to-argv conversion, route dispatch or HTTP result envelope of those app operations.
findings.reproduction: Run the read-only audit_semantics.py and inspect selected_function_endpoint_occurrences against the original_source and successor_sources for the named historical rows. This enumerates selected function bodies from the lossless 1209-node collection rather than searching unselected historical tests.
findings.impact: Passing test identities support the stated numerical coverage, but do not establish all maintained app workflow requirements. This is a validation-completeness finding, not a demonstrated runtime endpoint defect.
findings.required_resolution: Add bound local HTTP acceptance cases using disposable fixtures and fake provider outcomes for gates/status parity, valid review dry-run and ledger/honesty results; link their same-production passing outcomes to the affected historical rows and rerun only affected checks.

additional_limits: The fifth partial row in the semantic map concerns same-repository HTTP-vs-CLI status exit-code parity; it is included as a narrower coverage limitation rather than another finding.
